arxiv-2006-02240.title: Indoor and Outdoor Physical Channel Modeling and Efficient Positioning for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces in mmWave Bands
arxiv-2006-02240.creator: Ertugrul Basar, Ibrahim Yildirim, Fatih Kilinc
arxiv-2006-02240.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted communication appears as one of the potential enablers for sixth generation (6G) wireless networks by providing a new degree of freedom in the system design to telecom operators. Particularly, RIS-empowered millimeter wave (mmWave) communication systems can be a remedy to provide broadband and ubiquitous connectivity.

arxiv-2210-06621.title: A New Interference-Alignment Scheme for Wireless MapReduce
arxiv-2210-06621.creator: Yue Bi 1 2 , Michèle Wigger 2 , Yue Wu 1
arxiv-2210-06621.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yue Bi 1 2 , Michèle Wigger 2 , Yue Wu 1. We consider a full-duplex wireless Distributed Computing (DC) system under the MapReduce framework. New upper and lower bounds on the optimal tradeoff between Normalized Delivery Time (NDT) and computation load are presented. The upper bound strictly improves over the previous reported upper bounds and is based on a novel interference alignment (IA) scheme tailored to the interference cancellation capabilities of MapReduce nodes. The lower bound is proved through information-theoretic converse arguments.

arxiv-2401-01509.creator: Sirui Li, Wei Wang, Qi Zeng
arxiv-2401-01509.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sirui Li, Wei Wang, Qi Zeng. This article is concerned with the rigorous connections between the inertial Qian–Sheng model and the Ericksen–Leslie model for the liquid crystal flow, under a more general condition of coefficients.

arxiv-2405-08003.title: CONTINUOUS KRISHNA-PARTHASARATHY ENTROPIC UNCERTAINTY PRINCIPLE
arxiv-2405-08003.creator: Dedicated to the memory of Prof. K. R. Parthasarathy
arxiv-2405-08003.description: Abstract Abstract : In 2002, Krishna and Parthasarathy [ Sankhyā Ser. A ] derived discrete quantum version of Maassen-Uffink [ Phys. Rev. Lett., 1988 ] entropic uncertainty principle. In this paper, using the notion of continuous operator-valued frames, we derive an entropic uncertainty principle for arbitrary family of operators indexed by measure spaces having finite measure.

arxiv-2510-26398.title: On the asymmetric behaviour of turbulence in the wake of large offshore wind farms caused by the Coriolis force
arxiv-2510-26398.creator: Gabriele Centurelli 1,2, Joachim Peinke 1, Bughsin’ Djath 3, Johannes Schulz-Stellenfleth 3, Gerald Steinfeld 1,2
arxiv-2510-26398.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gabriele Centurelli 1,2, Joachim Peinke 1, Bughsin’ Djath 3, Johannes Schulz-Stellenfleth 3, Gerald Steinfeld 1,2. Large offshore wind farm wakes in shallow atmospheric boundary layers (ABL) exhibit often an asymmetric behaviour when observed through Synthetic-Aperture-Radar or simulated through Large-Eddy Simulations (LES). In previous LES of wind farms in the northern hemisphere, the asymmetry manifests as a streak at the left side of the wake, looking downstream, where the turbulence kinetic energy (TKE) is greater than the surrounding flow.

arxiv-2511-00935.title: Public Infrastructure Investments for Space Market Development
arxiv-2511-00935.creator: Akhil Rao
arxiv-2511-00935.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Akhil Rao. Advanced space technology systems often face high fixed costs, can serve limited non-government demand, and are significantly driven by non-market motivations. While increased entrepreneurial activity and national ambitions in space have encouraged planners at public space agencies to develop markets around such systems, the very factors that make the recent growth of the space economy so remarkable also challenge planners’ efforts to develop and sustain markets for space-related goods and services.

pmc-11545515.creator: Yu-Chen Chu, Chieh-Chih Tsai
pmc-11545515.description: Background/Objectives: Epiphora, or excessive tearing, is a common symptom often attributed to benign conditions such as dry eye or nasolacrimal duct obstruction. However, it can also be an early indicator of lacrimal sac tumors, which are frequently misdiagnosed or diagnosed late due to their subtle presentation.

pmc-12474461.title: Increase of Dengue in Pediatric Travelers in Madrid: A Multicentric Retrospective Experience
pmc-12474461.creator: Isabel Mellado-Sola, Sonia Milkova Ivanova, Milagros García López Hortelano, Paula Rodríguez-Molino, Cinta Moraleda, Sara Otero Alambillaga, Rut Fernández Martín, Francisco José Collado Díaz, Aida Sánchez García, Inés Ojeda Velázquez, Begoña Santiago-García, Talía Sainz
pmc-12474461.description: Dengue fever has significantly increased globally, extending into non-endemic regions. This study aims to describe the epidemiological and clinical characteristics of pediatric dengue cases diagnosed in Madrid, Spain, over ten years. We conducted a retrospective observational study across four tertiary hospitals, including all confirmed dengue cases in children under 16 between 2015 and 2024.

pmc-12518657.title: Assessment of ChatGPT performance in orbital MRI reporting with multimetric evaluation of transformer based language models
pmc-12518657.creator: Alessandro Tel, Federico Bolognesi, Luca Michelutti, Federico Biglioli, Massimo Robiony
pmc-12518657.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT-4, are increasingly used to streamline clinical practice, of which radiology reporting is a prominent aspect. However, their performance in interpreting complex anatomical regions from MRI data remains largely unexplored. This study investigates the capability of ChatGPT-4 to produce clinically reliable reports based on orbital MR images, applying a multimetric, quantitative evaluation framework in 25 patients with orbital lesions.

pmc-12621186.title: Lower Critical Solution Temperature Phase Behavior and Water Activity of a Ternary Mixture of Oleic Acid, Lidocaine, and Water
pmc-12621186.creator: Jordan D. Kocher, Ahmed Mahfouz, Hunter T. Bell, Joshua M. Rinehart, Akanksha K. Menon
pmc-12621186.description: Mixtures that possess a lower critical solution temperature (LCST) phase behavior form a homogeneous single phase at temperatures below the LCST and separate into two liquid phases (water-rich, WR, and water-scarce, WS) above the LCST. This unique thermoresponsive phase behavior can be leveraged in various thermodynamic cycles, which are used for applications such as desalination and dehumidification.

pmc-12734503.title: A Review of Transverse Mode Adaptive Control Based on Photonic Lanterns
pmc-12734503.creator: Yao Lu, Zongfu Jiang, Zilun Chen, Zhuruixiang Sun, Tong Liu
pmc-12734503.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). With the widespread application of fiber laser technology in industries, communications, medical fields, and beyond, the demand for controlling the spatial modes of their output beams has been increasingly growing. Traditional mode control methods are constrained by factors such as device power thresholds, system complexity, and cost, making it difficult to meet the requirements for high-power, high-purity, and rapidly switchable multimode regulation. This paper reviews adaptive mode control technology based on photonic lanterns (PLs).
